title: HIPAA Security and Privacy Rules
source: 45 CFR Part 164: Security Rule (Subpart C) and Privacy Rule (Subpart E)

controls.§164.312(a)(1): Access control: only people and software granted access rights can reach electronic PHI
controls.§164.312(b): Audit controls: mechanisms that record and examine activity in systems holding electronic PHI
controls.§164.312(c)(1): Integrity: electronic PHI protected from improper alteration or destruction
controls.§164.312(d): Person or entity authentication: whoever seeks access is the one claimed
controls.§164.308(a)(1)(ii)(D): Information system activity review: audit logs and access reports reviewed regularly
controls.§164.502(b): Minimum necessary: use and disclosure of PHI limited to what the purpose needs

limits.§164.312(d): Approvals are verified against the principals' keys in the charter. Tying those keys to the organization's identity provider is the deployment's job.
limits.§164.502(b): The bundle shows each plan was held to one chart and that a refused agent is told the rule, never the values. It does not record what an agent read through a read-only tool.
